notes.title: DEVLOG - Current State
notes.content:
[h2][b]DEVLOG - CURRENT STATE[/b][/h2][p]
The game is almost fully ready for the Early Access release. 

Currently, the active features in the game are as follows:
Detailed exterior/interior caravan customization
Camping equipment and camp mechanics
Fishing system (including earning money)
Petrol jobs (earning money)
Photography and quest systems
Various quests and jobs
Character mechanics (swimming, eating, drinking, toilet needs, etc.)
Traffic vehicle NPCs (various models)
Environmental NPCs (planes, helicopters, ships, etc.)
Day-night cycle
Weather variety
Drift festival area (drifting)
Exploration quests

[/p][h3][b]Wide variety of regions:[/b][/h3][p]Toscana
Island
Forest area
Snowy region
Arizona desert
And much more...
Visuals for all of these features are available.
All of them are ready for Early Access..


[/p][h3][b]You start from scratch and earn money to buy and design your dream caravan.[/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/60006e356e701300e59af757f0da3c3edc721ccb.jpg"][/img]


[/p][h3][b]Environment?[/b][/h3][p]The world of Caravanners is based on camping with your caravan. For example, the map design is similar to Forza Horizon, but offers a world not as dense as GTA4 or GTA5. Caravanners embraces a concept intertwined with nature. It features towns, small cities, long roads, and districts. It offers a variety of jobs and missions depending on the area. The world of Caravanners has a day-night cycle and different weather conditions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/da1f4ead48d142c7f4cb5f2e39d703b1c19629c9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/fe12aba36df0d84ae13aff409c3639c22a277837.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/e13b9a91786b478405307d977990e6ace38751e7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/222af7686e37eb8e6ff0cf6bb8813c4294a32300.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/e459877e95cdec5a299586e45d32faa8fd937334.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/37b0c01a9894ad4e9968b4ee1777af7075375a8e.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/e4f40d2c95dd2376d2354c6728c034e9dd32e545.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/66e69a994aaf97ca4adedb9ed98996f85823c480.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/71e0095c32bf081fa6aae684424996f7bf83aef9.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/08d866fdebac27067c6f86d8e155691ad62ac4ef.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]Snowland mini video (Underdev video)[/b][/h3][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H4ge1gf4TPM&ab_channel=Caravanners"][/dynamiclink]

[/p][h3][b]Rainiy[/b][/h3][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-wy5dfbYPWk"][/dynamiclink]

The entire map is not shown in this Devlog.




[/p][h3][b]Player mechanics?[/b][/h3][p]To survive, you need to eat and drink.
You can earn money and buy food or head to the lake and catch your own fish. The choice is yours.
But remember: you'll need to build a fire to cook any fish you catch.
And if you relieve yourself in nature, you'll be fined. 💸
So make sure to either install a toilet in your camper or find a public restroom.
Plan wisely  nature has its own rules.

❤️ Health Bar
🥩 Hunger Bar
🚰 Water Bar
🛌 Sleep Bar
🚽 Pee Bar
🏊 Swimming
🚬 Smoking
🚽 Toilet
🧘 Sit
🛌 Sleeping
🐟 Fishing
💪 Ability to carry objects
🚥 Driving License System (This feature may be postponed to a later date.)
👓 Reputation Point System
⛔ Sanction System 
💵 Money System

[/p][h3][b]Toilets underdev video[/b][/h3][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SX4-vM8cutY"][/dynamiclink]

[b]We’ll continue to add new mechanics and features through updates during the Early Access period, right after launch.
[/b]




[/p][h3][b]Drivable Vehicles?[/b][/h3][p]You'll start the game with an old, small kei truck.
With this little truck, you'll need to earn money and eventually buy your first van.

Once you own a van, you can begin customizing it and design the camper of your dreams.
But turning that dream into reality takes money... and time.

It's a journey.
A sweet road to your dreams! 🚐✨





[/p][h3][b]Van Customizations?[/b][/h3][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CjiH3J5BdTY&t=1s&ab_channel=Caravanners"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/1cec2939c3884897a112e9d8057d4ad6e4f18359.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/5f0e7d052b1560e86553495de60fdcf98d98d0a4.jpg"][/img]

Floor Material Selection
Wall Material Selection
Ceiling Material Selection
Bed 
Curtain

Cabinet Selection
Decor Selection
Refrigerator
Sink
Grill
Toilet

🪄 [b]Style:[/b] 
Seat, Bed, Curtain Fabric Selecion
Furniture Material Selection
Woods, Patterns, Colors

🟠 EXTERIOR CUSTOM
Body Color
Body Skins - Wraps
Wheel Color
Bumper Color
Front Bumper Selection
Back Bumper Selection
Wheel Selection

🟠 EXTERIOR ACCESSORIES 
Side Tent
Stair
Up Accessories

[b]After the Early Access launch, new vehicle customization options will be added frequently throughout the Early Access period including cockpit customization, exhaust choices, and more.[/b]



[/p][h3][b]What vehicles are available?[/b][/h3][p]Here are the vehicles currently available, but the number of vehicles will quickly increase with the first updates. As you know, the game is in early access, and we are growing it based on your requests. You can let us know which vehicles you want on Discord. Class A luxury bus caravans will be added after the early access launch through updates. By the time those updates arrive, you will likely have just finished your first T2 van. Currently, many caravans have completed their 3D modeling, and the software details are being prepare

[/p][h3][b]You can share a car with your friends, or you can combine multiple vehicles and form a convoy. In vans, your friends can even sit in the backseats.[/b][/h3][p]

[/p][h3][b]Mini Driving Test (Underdev)[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LqfkKbIi-GE"][/dynamiclink]


[/p][h3][b]Available Vehicles[/b][/h3][p][b]Kei pickup[/b] (Color customizable)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/18484df20df8e60943b7886f9146845bc8d5e247.jpg"][/img]
[b]T2 Van[/b] (Exterior and Interior detailed customizable)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/7953c00456a9ce0eceb41de2874899b0428c798f.jpg"][/img]
[b]Trailer[/b]
This trailer can be used with all vans and kei pickups. More trailer types will be available with updates. We're sure to have some big surprises in store.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/936939190d2040d3b6f1c3714aee83438c5c9985.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]Currently prepared vehicles[/b][/h3][p]As mentioned in the announcement, due to a major bug, we're rebuilding all the vans. Originally, all of these vehicles were ready. We're currently re-preparing them and working to deliver them quickly.  It may not be ready by launch. But even if it's not ready by launch, it will be ready within the first two weeks. 

Mer 310D: Detailed 3D models ready. Programming of the vehicle is in progress. (Developing)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/fb3c3eb8dd6d27fa00e2b7f0e3f9ff7344bb5986.jpg"][/img]
Maxcamper: Detailed 3D models ready. Programming of the vehicle is in progress. (Developing)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/411f04e60f9a332770463d8dfbe0430866ab0549.jpg"][/img]
GMG: Detailed 3D models ready. Programming of the vehicle is in progress. (Developing)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/60d9bfe69dfb2c5fb8a0959343a28aae36fada14.jpg"][/img]
Kordeco: 3D models ready. Programming of the vehicle is in progress. (Developing)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/784b28565e1c464e3b027584610df86eff4ecca9.jpg"][/img]
Noxer: Detailed 3D models ready. Programming of the vehicle is in progress. (Developing)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/babd67d9a389a884ca3a985a136b72c8e2bc1fc0.jpg"][/img]
And more Van vehicles will coming!


[/p][h3][b]A Class Luxury Vehicles Will coming with updates[/b][/h3][p][b]We attach great importance to these types of vehicles and we do special work for A-class luxury vehicles.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/cc6d92e2bcf20dd27ad24e4b91c9b7e0c947b80f.png"][/img]




[/p][h3][b]Vehicle Engine System[/b][/h3][p]
You can upgrade the engine in van vehicles. There are a total of 3 engine levels. As you upgrade, the vehicle's performance improves. Engine upgrades can be done inside the technical garage and require payment.

At high speeds, the engine can overheat, and your vehicle may experience heat-related issues. When this happens, you must wait briefly for the engine to cool down. As you upgrade the engine, the chance of overheating decreases due to improved cooling efficiency.

Fuel consumption also varies depending on the engine level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/c22a6e838f8fa988458eb45cd0c42902c02c6ee0.jpg"][/img]




[/p][h3][b]Vehicle breakdown [/b][/h3][p]A vehicle has an engine health. This can deteriorate depending on various factors. When the engine breaks down, you click on the engine to call for service. You then teleport to the mechanic. You can repair your vehicle at the service center. 

With future updates, newer repair mechanics will be introduced. (Tire bursts and other breakdowns)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/a8389ef708853366422d25fb457b914cdd234f1d.jpg"][/img]



[/p][h3][b]Fuel?[/b][/h3][p]
There are many gas stations on the map. These stations offer restrooms and some items for purchase.

You can drive to the station and fill up with gas. Manual refueling is not currently available. However, with the update, you'll be able to refuel yourself. Fuel consumption also varies depending on your engine level and speed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/921270e73fb67a73f0237690301519f517814ecb.jpg"][/img]



[/p][h3][b]Vehicle Washing System[/b][/h3][p]Your vehicle gets dirty over time. When it does, you can have it washed for a fee.

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lid-Censvcc&ab_channel=Caravanners"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/a58122deef55c987564d539f5866b66378be80cf.jpg"][/img]




[/p][h2][b]Camping Features[/b][/h2][p]
🔥 Portable fire pit. Works with coal. You can light a fire wherever you want.

🥩🔥 Barbecue for cooking meat. It works with coal. You can fill it with coal, light a fire and cook meat wherever you want.

🥩 🐟 Various meats and fish for the barbecue. You can cook and eat on the barbecue.

🥫 Some canned foods.

⛺️ Design your own campsite. Portable and buildable, awnings. Awnings are available in different sizes.

🌠  Portable, foldable table.

🪑 Portable, foldable chair.

 🍾 Portable, drinkable water bottles.

🧰  Plastic camping box for transporting and storing equipment.

🚽  Portable toilet so you can pee without polluting the environment.

📥  Portable coals for starting a fire.

📻  Radio for listening to music by the fire in the forest.

🐟 Fishing

And more...

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fho4Ymjfz24&t=2s&ab_channel=Caravanners"][/dynamiclink]





[/p][h3][b]Fishing and Swimmable Lakes[/b][/h3][p]The map features numerous swimmable lakes located in various areas. You can fish in these lakes using a fishing rod. Fishing cannot be done while swimming. Currently, fishing is only available in lakes.

The reason for this is that the map includes hundreds of kilometers of ocean, and enabling fishing in such a vast area is technically challenging and not yet ready. We plan to enable sea fishing in future updates.

However, for now, the lakes are more than sufficient. There are plenty of large lakes with beautiful scenery, offering a great fishing experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/b5c1ceb7188b8fa0b81da1cd57ccf08984bad1a3.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/89d3f46061a6ab35bde062fa172da5c414b63229.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/16a966f31c5630be5117f156ef9156894c633975.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/279f7c623818be70331ed1e8dca7bcd428186e4d.png"][/img]




[/p][h3][b]Purchasable small storage units[/b][/h3][p]
You can purchase and use storage units as you wish. There are warehouses in many locations on the map. There's a plaque at the storage entrance where you can write your name. This way, when playing with friends, everyone can designate their own storage unit. Electricity is charged at storage units. When the electricity runs out, you'll need to purchase it again.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/3170e17b420bded0094842d0f7ab9af2eb9faa75.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/54da1ec76c254b4e1c44d82fe252a2aad3f6213d.jpg"][/img]
Depot video (Low graphic settings)
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5HLgS9AL57w"][/dynamiclink]

[b]There will also be different structures available for purchase.[/b]


[/p][h3][b]Traffic?[/b][/h3][p]Cars, trucks and vans of different sizes are driving on the roads.


[/p][h3][b]Missions and Money Earning[/b][/h3][p]
There are various ways to earn money. For example, you can go to the oil trading center and buy oil barrels. You can fill the barrels at the oil pumps and sell them back to the oil trading center.

You can earn both reputation points and money by clearing certain areas in nature.

Fishing and selling the fish you catch.

Photography tasks and earning money.

There are many ways to earn money.

There are also many exploration missions. There are certain tasks you must complete in various locations on the map. These missions allow you to explore many locations on the map. In keeping with the spirit of Caravanners, there are missions focused on travel and exploration.

[/p][h3][b]Petrol Trade Work Devlog video[/b][/h3][p]The video was prepared with low graphics settings. It shows how to make money by selling oil barrels.
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MHjiIJDM7OE"][/dynamiclink]

Our game will be released in early access soon. There is a lot for you to discover.
[/p]

notes.title: TOSCANA REGION
notes.content:
🌿[h2][b] New Region Unlocked: Welcome to Toscana! [/b][/h2]🍇🌄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/fe12aba36df0d84ae13aff409c3639c22a277837.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Ready to escape into the heart of Italy?[/b][/h2]
Toscana arrives in our game  bringing peaceful landscapes, Mediterranean charm, and a touch of timeless beauty.

🚗 Endless vineyards, towering cypress trees, winding roads lined with stone walls…
This isn't just a new map it's a world full of character and atmosphere.

🛻 Drive your rusty old truck or van through narrow village paths, pass under the shadow of the bell tower, or simply cruise under the Tuscan sun.
This region offers both visual delight and fresh gameplay experiences.

✨ Cool mornings beneath the cypress shade, the distant shimmer of the sea, and that unmistakable Mediterranean vibe...
Toscana isn’t just a place it’s a feeling.

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Design your dream van
notes.content:
Caravanners will soon be Released as Early Access. We want to provide as much content as possible in Early Access. In this way, those who buy our game in Early Access will both support us during the Early Access period and you will have an advantage when you buy it at the Early Access price. After a while in Early Access, the price will increase slightly with major updates. 


[h3][b]Design your dream van[/b][/h3]

Whether you want a solid black design, a bohemian white caravan, a caravan in pink dreams or a retro caravan with lots of wood, you are completely free.

[h3][b]We have made great progress in caravan furniture customization.[/b][/h3]

[b]Appliances[/b]
You can create your own living space by placing a refrigerator, grill, toilet inside your caravan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/515ce6105b5ac1d9c6c546dd2dfb98e195538d1a.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot

[b]Materials[/b]
You will be able to change both the fabrics and the material of the furniture inside your caravan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/081679ab498e83ae45d13e8805959bcff6b6debb.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot

[b]Decor[/b]
You can place some decorations on your furniture and adjust their rotation. You can decorate your caravan with decorations such as books, magazines, flowers, kitchenware.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/eb272c24dd82af92426d3643aa7b34d65d4b8297.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot


[b]Curtain[/b]
Curtains are of great importance in a caravan. You can install curtains on any window in the caravan to isolate your living space and close and open them whenever you want. You can also choose the pattern of your curtain according to your own taste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/89f920cc6fdce5fbec4ed8f8964e1c5e772992f2.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot


[b]Exterior customization[/b]
You can change the colors of your caravan. Instead of solid colors, you can also apply vehicle wraps to your caravan. You can also change the rim colors of your vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/5f0e7d052b1560e86553495de60fdcf98d98d0a4.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/f114d2efe48a4b8458988d104ce513e27cac6414.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/51762bec20b12ee7dcfff029ba7b5831ebe6f49e.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/f31f01da0bc5d5cfedf68cb55b6cfb53957be3c0.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597188/188541c20c4ff07311ae90bc59da40edd2c55cd7.jpg[/img]
Under development Screen Shot


You can change the rims of your caravans. You can also change the bumpers and body kits of some caravans. 

We are currently working on different customizations for exterior customization, such as country flags, license plate customization, exhaust customization. 

We attach importance to customization. Because it makes us happy that you can design your dream caravan and mobile living space.

By joining our Discord server, you can quickly be informed about all developments.
[url=https://discord.gg/HcRxVNu34k]Discord[/url]

notes.title: DESIGN YOUR CAMP
notes.content:
[h2][b]DESIGN YOUR CAMP[/b][/h2]

We are currently working on enriching the camp mechanics. 

You will now be able to create some structures with the build system.
